strings.string: Every routine's holds are set from the guidance. Gentle shortens them, deep makes them half as long again. Before an activity they stay short whatever you pick.
In the full-body and after-activity routines: push gently against the stretch for five seconds, relax, then ease a little further. Optional; leave off if you are new to stretching or sore.
Each routine is saved as Flexibility Training, with a lap per stretch.
A tone with each buzz, for stretching with the watch out of sight.
